run_projective_texture_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that renders a teddy bear with projective texture from the camera view
load_urdf_models: load URDF models like plane.urdf and teddy_large.urdf into a pybullet physics simulation
get_camera_image_with_projective_texture: get a camera image using ER_USE_PROJECTIVE_TEXTURE flag with view and projection matrices from the debug visualizer camera
load_texture: load a texture file like checker_grid.jpg into pybullet for use with visual shapes
set_realtime_simulation: enable real-time simulation mode in pybullet and configure gravity and camera settings
